name: Purposeless, oversized code
problem: Files that cannot be traced to a purpose stay because deleting them feels risky, and modules grow until they are too long to read whole (one adapter file reached thousands of lines).
who_has_it: Maintainers, and AI agents whose context fills with code that does not matter to the task.
why_it_matters: Every unowned line costs reading, testing and risk, and hides the parts that matter.
why_hard: AI writes code faster than anyone prunes it, and without a record of purpose there is no basis to delete.
existing_attempts: Dead-code finders (vulture), code owners files, size linters, periodic clean-up passes.
